caption: The drawing features a single, centrally placed, oval-shaped table with a black or very dark brown top. The tabletop is smooth and evenly shaded, displaying subtle gradations to create a sense of three-dimensionality and light reflection. The table has a thick, cylindrical pedestal base that is also shaded in dark tones, transitioning from black at the top to slightly lighter shades toward the bottom. The base supports the tabletop and sits on a rectangular platform composed of several parallel lines, with the corners terminating in tightly coiled scrolls. The shading technique throughout the drawing creates depth and highlights the form of the object. The background is a plain off-white color, and there are no additional objects or decorations present in the drawing.
title: Dining Room Suite
